summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Prayer Time Reminder PWA with location permission flow. All 10 requested features passed. Location permission modal appears on first visit with 'Konum İzni' title. Clicking 'Hayır, Erzincan' correctly sets Erzincan as default city and persists to localStorage. Notification permission modal appears after location prompt. City selector shows all 81 Turkish provinces, changes prayer times correctly, and persists selection. Prayer times load from Diyanet API (ezanvakti.emushaf.net). Countdown timer works. Ramadan progress bar visible (Day 11 - 38%). Settings modal has notifications and silent mode toggles. All UI text is in Turkish.
passed_tests: ✅ Location permission modal appears on first visit with 'Konum İzni' title
✅ Modal shows decline button 'Hayır, Erzincan' and accept button 'Evet, Konumumu Bul'
✅ Clicking 'Hayır, Erzincan' sets default city to Erzincan
✅ location-prompt-shown flag set to 'true' after location prompt handled
✅ Notification permission modal 'Bildirim İzni' appears after location prompt
✅ City selector shows all 81 Turkish provinces
✅ City selection changes prayer times (verified Erzincan vs İstanbul have different times)
✅ Prayer times load from Diyanet API (ezanvakti.emushaf.net) - 6 prayer times displayed
✅ Countdown timer works and counts down to next prayer
✅ Ramadan progress bar visible - showing Day 11 (38%)
✅ Settings modal opens with notifications toggle and silent mode toggle
✅ Theme toggle switches between dark and light mode
✅ Ramazan İmsakiyesi (monthly calendar) modal shows 32+ days of prayer times
✅ All UI text is in Turkish (Saat, Dakika, Saniye, İmsak, Güneş, Öğle, İkindi, Akşam, Yatsı)
action_items: Minor: Add aria-describedby to DialogContent in Settings modal to fix accessibility warning
critical_code_review_comments: Location permission flow implemented correctly with proper localStorage handling
City detection using Haversine formula for finding nearest city is well implemented
API caching implemented for Diyanet prayer times (localStorage cache with date key)
Ramadan date detection using Aladhan API with proper fallback dates
